title: Ask
description: An ask as the agent sends it to the ask tool (AD-7): its ID, the optional fields, and exactly one plain question in E1, in English only. A presentation and a delivery mode are accepted: a board of one question is the single-question board whatever they say (EXPERIENCE, Presentations). Further checks the schema cannot express run in the contract's validation function: unique item IDs, the reserved view-made prefix, unique option labels and the room an answer needs.
